response.text: {"findings":[{"level":2,"severity":"blocking","finding":"The statement 'The paper shows that vaccinating every newborn would eliminate tuberculosis within ten years' is not supported by the paper and is marked as a quote from the paper.","suggestion":"Remove the claim that vaccinating newborns eliminates TB within ten years and replace it with a statement about how increasing the vaccination rate $\\pi$ reduces the reproduction number $\\mathscr{R}_v$."},{"level":3,"severity":"blocking","finding":"The claim that the epidemic 'doubles in size and the disease can never be controlled' is worded much more strongly than the measurement (only 6 more exposed people at year 10).","suggestion":"Change the statement to reflect a modest increase in the exposed population rather than claiming the epidemic doubles or becomes uncontrollable."}]}
